canonical.title: Self-Hosted PaaS for Homelab PR Previews: Decision Framework 2026

children.title: Coolify on a proper Linux VM
children.summary: Coolify does native per-PR preview deploys and is the obvious homelab PaaS — but install it in a dedicated Debian VM, not an LXC or shared Docker host, and patch the Jan 2026 RCEs first.

children.title: Roll-your-own bash/compose wrapper
children.summary: A field guide to wiring up a DIY bash + docker-compose PR preview stack on a single Debian VM: triggers, deploy scripts, reverse proxy, cleanup, and when it beats Coolify.

children.title: Dokploy
children.summary: Dokploy is a Docker-native open-source PaaS (⭐ 34.6k) with first-class PR preview deployments, Swarm-based multi-node scaling, and an AI-powered CLI/MCP server.

children.title: CapRover
children.summary: CapRover is battle-tested and resource-light but lacks native PR preview environments and true multi-service Docker Compose support.

children.title: Dokku
children.summary: Dokku is the lightest self-hosted PaaS — 95 MB RAM idle, Heroku-compatible git-push workflow, excellent plugin ecosystem.

children.title: Kamal 2
children.summary: Kamal 2 is a minimal Docker deployment tool optimized for simplicity and resource efficiency.

children.title: Secrets and credential handling across options
children.summary: Environment variables alone are insufficient for secrets in 2026; use a secrets manager for sensitive data.
